name: ScriptableObjectTableWindow
src_typeComment: Toolkit/ScriptableObject Table View: select several ScriptableObject assets of the SAME concrete type in the Project window and see/edit every one of them side by side as spreadsheet rows — including dragging in a different Object/ScriptableObject reference directly in a cell, which just works because every cell is drawn with Unity's own SerializedProperty field drawer (the same one the normal Inspector uses), not a hand-rolled per-type renderer. Deliberately kept SEPARATE from EditorTools/CsvTableEditor — that tool edits plain CSV files, this one edits real asset objects through the normal serialization pipeline (full Undo support, proper asset dirtying, no export/import round-trip).  Known limitation: a field that draws as a multi-line block in the normal Inspector (a List<T>, a nested [Serializable] class) still does that here too — it expands vertically inside its cell rather than collapsing into a compact one-line summary, which looks fine for one or two such fields but gets messy with several. This tool is at its best comparing mostly scalar/reference fields side by side.

src_members.name: CollectFieldNames
src_members.comment: Walks the FIRST object's visible serialized properties (skipping m_Script, the header field every ScriptableObject carries) to get the column set — the same top-level property walk DrawDefaultInspector uses internally, just collected once into names instead of drawn immediately.
